about: HOU-148: what a person says to the house, and the tool calls they would expect. QA-6 (HOU-86) grows this into the scored eval. `expect` lists every acceptable sequence of tool calls, in order. `ahead` (HOU-156): every set_mode call names a later day in `from` (true), or none does (false).
